tariffs.title: Tariffs
tariffs.description: The fees set for this product, such as the rates of a fee regulation. A tariff with a later valid-from date replaces the one with the same label from that day.

label.description: What the tariff is called, such as the rate of a fee regulation.
label.title: Tariff

validFrom.description: The day the tariff applies from.
validFrom.title: Valid from

note.description: A note on the tariff, such as when it applies.
note.title: Note

tariffSource.title: Tariff source
tariffSource.description: Where the tariffs come from, such as the fee regulation and its chapter.

publishedAt.title: Publication date
publishedAt.description: The day the product was first published to residents and businesses.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: The languages the product is published in, as two-letter codes (nl, en).

weightGrams.title: Weight (g)
weightGrams.description: The weight in grams, for an item too light to state in kilograms with two decimals. When set, it is shown instead of the weight in kilograms.
